title: The Steps as we know them
description:
In The Steps as we know them, you use the moves of chess to find your way through different worlds. It is a puzzle game with a relaxing atmosphere. The game has simple mechanics, but is challenging at the same time.

Different situations
Every world you come across uses a different chess piece and brings a different tactic with it. The levels build up from the easy moves of a pawn to the difficult situations of a knight. Sometimes you can work your way through by being stubborn. In other levels you have to take a step back and take a second look.

The game• 6 worlds

• 6 different chess pieces

• ~7 levels per world

• From easy to complicated
description_short: Use the moves of chess to solve puzzles. Find your way with six different pieces, through six different worlds. Use a varying way of thinking in each world.
